Official student curriculum for 2026 entrants. Gives the three-year sequence, required methods and thesis preparation.

The retrieved 2026–2027 PDF, Article 3.3 and 3.5 and Appendices 1–3. Controls track, credit, component order, advanced credit and profiling requirements. The full PDF was retrieved directly and checked by its internal year headings because one indexed result redirected to the older regulations.
Official thesis guidance confirms Republic of Letters as the preparatory course and the supervised 7.5 EC thesis.
Official current course planner LI3V14001 confirms at least 120 EC earned and 22.5 EC at advanced level before the thesis.
Official current planner LI3V18001 describes the literary field, production and circulation, literary institutions and digital and quantitative research.

curriculum: The target is the full-time Dutch registration. The OER also describes a separate English track in the same degree. The Dutch-track example is 180 EC: a 120 EC major and 60 EC profiling space. Article 3.5 and Appendices 1 and 2 give 75 EC of mandatory coursework, comprising the two foundational packages, Literary Toolbox and The Republic of Letters. The thesis is a separate 7.5 EC. Add one 30 EC depth package and one 7.5 EC context elective to reach 120 EC. Literature Across Borders and Retorica are the first-listed choices and independent of UCR fit. The five advanced courses in the four-course depth package and Literary Toolbox plus Current Debates, Republic of Letters and the thesis give 60 EC at level 3, above the 45 EC major minimum. The 60 EC profiling space must include a coherent 30 EC package, such as a minor, study abroad or another depth package. Choices requiring approval remain open.
progression: The first year uses the two four-course foundational packages. The four depth courses run in order across the four blocks of Year 2, with Literary Toolbox in Block 3. Retorica is in Block 4 and may be placed in Year 3 if it conflicts with the depth course. The Year 3 Republic of Letters course is in Block 1. The thesis requires at least 120 EC and 22.5 EC at level 3, both reached on the standard progression after completing the first two years including profiling and the depth package. The thesis can follow Republic of Letters in a later block. The graduation requirements separately include at least 45 advanced EC in the major.
